name: Lockpick
concept: A lock-picking set as a 1989 locksmith or burglar carries it: a hook pick and a tension wrench in a small leather wallet. Used on a locked door, it opens it by skill.
prompt: Modelled in Blender by model.py: a small stitched leather wallet with a steel hook pick and a flat L tension wrench laid on it under two leather straps, their tips sticking out past the wallet, a brass snap on its foot. no text, no logos.

textures.use: pick and wrench steel: scratches and roughness
wallet: worn brown leather grain, scuffs and pores
